newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Nov 1-25 palm oil exports 555,070t- SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Nov 1-25 palm oil exports 555,070t- SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for November 1-25 at 555,070 tonnes against 615,327 tonnes for October 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 157,552 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 217,132 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 58,813 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 121,573 tonnes.
China, which was the main buyer during the period, taking 82,200 tonnes, India at 65,912 tonnes, Egypt at 45,500 and Pakistan at 43,100 tonnes.
Countries in the European Union bought 55,912 tonnes.
